budget_items.topic: Franchise fee increase and town revenue share
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The proposal seeks 5% of gross annual revenues, about $200,000 per year, versus the 2.5% (about $100,000) Lunenburg currently receives.
budget_items.quote: revenues; which represents approx. $200,000 per year. lunenburg currently receives 2.5%;

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee's capital request is $240,000, compared with a current license of $115,000.
budget_items.quote: we are looking for $240,000 in capital

budget_items.topic: Franchise related cost and subscriber bill impact
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Comcast stated current franchise related cost is $.36 per subscriber; with 11% interest on capital costs the cost is stated as approximately $.75, and $.28 on capital without interest; a fee increase from 2.5% to 5% would raise subscriber bills.
budget_items.quote: current franchise related cost (frc) is $.36 per subscriber.

budget_items.topic: Video return line from high school to Town Hall
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Comcast will get an estimate on the video return line, which may cost less than $10,000.
budget_items.quote: will get an estimate on the video return line (may be less than $10,000).

budget_items.topic: Town and school business services spending
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg's town and school together spend about $3,000 per month on business services, which the committee said makes the requested increases more palatable.
budget_items.quote: currently between the town and school lunenburg is currently spending about $3,000 per month on business services.
